candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `pot += msg.value;` so the pot is never increased on play.

Delete the statement `pot = 0;` so the pot is not reset after a win.
Replace `pot = 0;` with `pot = FEE_AMOUNT;` so the pot is set to the fee amount instead of zero after a win.
Move `pot = 0;` to before the transfer to msg.sender, causing `pot - FEE_AMOUNT` to underflow and revert while leaving the pot at 0 in any surviving path.
Remove the statement resetting pot to zero after a win, so pot retains its value after a winning play.
Remove the accumulation of msg.value into pot, so the pot never grows after a play.
Replace the accumulation 'pot += msg.value' with an assignment 'pot = msg.value', so pot no longer accumulates across plays.
Change the winning condition from 'random == 0' to 'random == 1', so the pot is reset (and prizes paid) on a different outcome.

Remove the statement `pot += msg.value;` so the pot is never credited.
Remove the statement `pot = 0;` so the pot retains its balance after a win.
Replace `pot += msg.value;` with `pot = msg.value;` so prior pot contributions are discarded.
Move `pot = 0;` out of the if-block to execute on every play call.
